messages:
maria: Heads-up — planning to pin model aurora-3b-v2 to the catalog at 09:00 PT today. Small window (09:00–09:15 PT). Need someone to run the smoke checks and a rollback owner. PR: https://git.company/repo/pulls/5421 :wave:
jon: I can run smoke. Which infra slot is this hitting?
maria: It will hit slot-pool-4 (staging-like capacity). Perf looks fine in perf tests.
ash: (typo) meant to say ash — i can be rollback if needed.
ash: jk — ash will take rollback.
ash: also quick question: do we need a canary for 10% first or full pin?
maria: Full pin for this slot — we've validated traffic profiles and latency. Canary was done during validation.
jon: ok. I'll be at my desk at 08:55 PT and will run smoke at 09:02 PT.
olivia: tagging @kevin for console rollout visibility. Kevin, can you watch the monitor dash for any cost/latency regressions?
kevin: on it. I'll flag any >10% p99 increase.
sre-bot: reminder: oncall is @oncall-ml for incident escalation.
maria: Smoke checklist (short):
```
1) curl health ok: GET https://catalog.internal/aurora-3b-v2/health -> 200
2) quick gen sample: POST /v1/generate {"prompt": "Hello world"} -> tokens within 150ms
3) KV cache test: send same prefix twice, second should be faster
4) logs: grep for unusual OOM/errors in /var/log/inference/*
```
jon: copying smoke steps into my terminal. I'll paste results here.
jon: START SMOKE -> curl health 200 OK.
jon: gen sample latency 130ms, output sanity check OK.
jon: second prefix call latency 45ms. KV cache effective.
jon: no OOM traces in logs, only expected warmup messages.
aj: (typo) ash: rollback readiness check?
ash: Rollback plan: alias swap back to aurora-3b-v1 (db entry catalog.aliases), command: `POST /admin/alias/swap {"alias":"aurora","target":"aurora-3b-v1"}`. I will run if we see >20% error increase or functional regressions.
maria: Thanks — keeping rollback who/command explicit is good.
kevin: dashboards look stable so far. p99 +2% (within noise).
deploy-bot: [09:05:12] deploy started by maria (PR #5421) -> slot-pool-4
maria: Deploy in progress, doing post-deploy smoke now.
jon: POST-deploy gen latency 140ms, outputs look good on 10 sample prompts. No hallucination spikes.
kevin: no cost anomalies.
maria: Great. I'll leave the pin for 09:10 PT if everyone still green.
jon: LGTM from smoke side.
ash: standing down, rollback not needed.
maria: Pin completed at 09:10 PT. Thanks all — I'll update the catalog changelog and close the PR. :tada:
olivia: leaving a note in #release-notes for customers using aurora alias.
kevin: will follow up with a 24h perf sweep.
deploy-bot: [09:11:05] deploy complete.
sre-bot: incident watch: none triggered.
maria: Closing thread — ping me if anything pops in next hour.
